title: Seven- and eight-loop critical exponents of the three-dimensional Ising model
summary: We determine the critical exponents $η$, $ν$, and the correction-to-scaling exponent $ω$ of the three-dimensional Ising universality class by resumming the recently computed seven- and eight-loop renormalization-group series in the $ε=4-d$ expansion (O.~Schnetz, \textit{Phys. Rev. D} \textbf{97}, 085018 (2018); O.~Schnetz, \textit{Phys. Rev. D} \textbf{107}, 036002 (2023)). The resummation combines conformal mapping with a homographic transformation, while the resummation parameters are optimized according to two complementary criteria.
